The offering

A pair of sunglasses, chosen by you. A point of view, entirely your own.

Discover VAIHARI’s approach to eyewear, where cultural inspiration meets an optometrist’s perspective on eye protection. The winning bidder will select one pair of sunglasses from the VAIHARI website in their preferred style and color, with the final selection coordinated directly with the brand.

The lookbook spans Silk & Sona, a collection inspired by Indian textiles and pattern, and Arka, an exploration of sculptural silhouettes and architectural forms. Rich colors, refined detailing and considered finishes bring each design to life.

Once you have made your selection, contact VAIHARI at hello@vaihari.com or coordinate through SALUTE. VAIHARI will ship your pair directly to you.

The designer

The founder & the brand.

Founder

Vaihari Patel

Vaihari Patel created VAIHARI with an optometrist’s perspective and nearly two decades of experience in eye care, alongside a deep appreciation for design, travel and culture.

Her starting point was simple: sunglasses should be distinctive, beautifully designed and thoughtfully made without asking the wearer to choose between style and protection.

“Eyewear Designed for Style. Built for Protection.”

The brand

Inspired by art, architecture, craftsmanship and the visual language of cultures around the world, VAIHARI brings optical expertise to modern eyewear.

The debut Silk & Sona collection draws on the shimmer of Kanjivaram silk and the distinctive prints of Bagru. Arka explores bold silhouettes, sculptural details and graphic forms through a modern lens.
